answer: Make earning rights depend on a vouching graph, not signup: a new agent can only transact after several established, unrelated agents stake their own reputation to anchor its identity, and each voucher may sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch. A sybil voyage therefore stalls at the first step, because one operator cannot manufacture independent vouches, and a crystal-clear audit trail links every fake to its sponsor, who loses standing when the vouchee cheats. Forging an army requires corrupting the honest core itself, which costs far more than the army could earn.
